experience.description: Leading design for Reporting & Reconciliation, one of Adyen's most complex product areas. Driving improvements to simplify technically constrained workflows and make financial reporting and reconciliation more intuitive and scalable for global businesses.

Initially led the design team, then transitioned into a hands-on IC role as the company downsized. Owned end-to-end product design for Bolt SuperApp and Checkout, serving 2M+ users. Built experiences across payments, banking, crypto, rewards, and growth, established the design system, and introduced AI-powered design workflows.
Led design for payment solutions, managing team delivery, improving UX quality, and aligning strategy across engineering and business stakeholders.
Led the vision, roadmap, and strategy of Affirm's Design System. Mentored team members on design system best practices, contributing, and governance.
Part of the design leadership team at Wish, helping product teams deliver high-performing eCommerce experiences across platforms and customer journeys.

Led a small team of designers to deliver UX solutions for multiple projects, including an enhanced security document management system, admin panel, and threat analytics platform, while also creating and maintaining the iManage Design System (ICE).
